No expression involving chern, ahat or witten computes characteristicClass or links those optional components to formula.

Full captured CohomologyClass source was read. ClassEquality.equal genuinely requires equality of the two class degrees, a.degree = b.degree. It does not state equality of the dependent class values, a transport equation between them, or an index integral/product formula. This real degree-equality premise is recognized and preserved.

ClassEquality.compatible : Prop is a separately arbitrary field paired with a witness. characteristic_formula_compatible is a real conditional proof projecting Phi.formula.compatible_certified; it does not prove equality of class values or expose the genuine degree equality as its conclusion.

formulaIsAtiyahSingerStyle : Prop is arbitrary with a supplied proof. characteristic_formula_is_index_style genuinely projects that supplied witness; the label does not define an Atiyah-Singer formula or prove the index theorem.

Optional records may be none and are not linked to characteristicClass by this source.
